hoenn.flavorText: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

updated-johto.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Dusclops absorbs anything, however large the object may be. This Pokémon hypnotizes its foe by waving its hands in a macabre manner and by bringing its single eye to bear. The hypnotized foe is made to do Dusclops’s bidding.
